rows.en:
So Colonel Zol is dead… A head-on showdown is spirited enough, but once you're dead, that's the end of it.

Still, with Colonel Zol around, there was all harm and no benefit… With this, the Japan Branch is mine. Now the Japan Branch's all-out offensive begins!

Traitors Takeshi Hongo and Hayato Ichimonji… I will perform brain modification surgery on you with my own hands! And you will become members of Shocker! For the glory of the great Shocker!
Colonel Zol, commander of Shocker's Japan Branch, was defeated by our heroes.
But the new top executive, Doctor Death, bared his fangs at them with a cruelty surpassing even Colonel Zol's. Once again, dark clouds gathered over the peace of Japan…
Defeat the Shocker cyborgs!
Defeat all Shocker Executive Monsters and Combatants!
Defeat Executive Monster Golden Wolf!
Hayato Ichimonji is defeated
<c3>Retsu Ichijouji</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Retsu Ichijouji</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
No support units available! Capture is now <c1>impossible</c>.
On Planet Bird, a beautiful planet in the vastness of space, stands the headquarters of the Galactic Union Police, guardians of justice and order in the universe.
Its chief, Kom, entrusts a special mission to one of his Space Sheriffs… His name is Gavan. A capable Space Sheriff born of a Birdian father and an Earthling mother.
Commander Kom!
Gavan… How is the super-dimensional high-speed ship Dolgiran?

Sir!

Dolgiran was damaged in the battle with him, but its repairs are finally complete. Space Sheriff Gavan will now take up duty as officer for the Earth sector.

Mm… Gavan, there's something I want to tell you!

On the planet called Earth, watch out for a man who calls himself Hunter Killer!

The former Space Sheriff Hunter Killer betrayed us and has become a member of Makuu.
That planet is also my mother's homeland. I won't let Makuu do as they please!
Don't let your guard down!
I'll pray for your luck, Gavan…
Thank you, Marine!
Father, Mother… I'm going to Earth now to face Makuu! Please watch over me…
Gavan, you're terrible! Where do you think you're going all by yourself?

Mimi!? Why did you stow away on this ship? I'm going to Earth now!

Mimi, there's still time… Take the auxiliary ship and go back to Planet Bird.
No! I'm going to Earth too… with you, Gavan!
Don't go saying whatever you like just because you're Commander Kom's daughter!
Gavan… Where you are is where I am! I've already decided that, so there.
Mimi…
Commander Kom! Space Sheriff Gavan will now take up duty as officer for the Earth sector.

Listen well… We of Makuu must colonize Earth and turn it into a planet full of crime.

Rob the humans of their good hearts and plant demonic souls in them! Take whatever can be taken… Make a bloody sacrifice of Tokyo, Japan!
Gii, giii!
Shako Monster!!
Shuuu, shuuu…
Battle carrier, launch!! We now begin the invasion of Tokyo. Go!!

We will build our Makuu forward base here!

Begin transporting the weapons and materials! All the treasure and talent on Earth belong to us!

Plunder! Burn everything! With Japan as our foothold, we'll build Makuu bases all over the world!

Leave it to me…

Go, Crusher Soldiers!
Emergency message from the TDF! An attack by an unknown armed group in Shinjuku. They're requesting that we sortie!

An unknown armed group!?

So yet another new enemy has appeared?
All right, let's go take a look anyway. We need to let Hongo and the others know, too…

But… Mr. Hongo is at the university lab modifying the Cyclone.

Unless it's something serious, if we call him… he won't be able to finish modifying the Cyclone.
That's right… He said the Cyclone's enhancement was essential to prepare for the battles against Shocker ahead…

But… with a new enemy on the move, will we be all right on our own?

What'll we do, [HERO2]?
"We need Hongo after all…" "We'll handle it ourselves this time."
Hey, emergency message from the TDF! Apparently an unknown armed group is running wild in Shinjuku! They're requesting that we sortie too!
Whaaat!? I've only had one bite of Boss's new "Amigo Parfait"…

An unknown armed group?

So you mean yet another new enemy has appeared?

No way!! Mr. Hongo's at the university lab. He's modifying the Cyclone.

We'd be bothering him for sure. He won't be able to finish modifying the Cyclone…
Yeah… He said the Cyclone's enhancement was essential to prepare for the battles against Shocker ahead…

But… with a new enemy on the move, will we be all right on our own?

What'll we do, [HERO2]?
"We need Mr. Hongo after all." "Let's handle it ourselves this time."
Right… All right, I'll get in touch with him.
Right… We'll handle it ourselves! The Cyclone's modification has to get done.

Curses… So you mean to get in our way?

Come forth! Bem Monster Shako Monster!
This is another dimension… Here, in a space cut off from all phenomena, stood Makuu's headquarters, the Demon Castle.
Don Horror, the boss of Makuu and the wielder of mighty psychic powers, gave his subordinates their orders!
Drag them into Makuu Space! Activate the axis-shift device…

Ha ha ha…

Our Makuu can manipulate the planet's axis and create Makuu Space, which resembles a black hole!!

Inside Makuu Space, Bem Monsters draw on Makuu energy and gain several times their power.

…!?

This is a spatial-distortion weapon! The only things that can fight in here are our Roaring Steel suits with their spatial-synchronization fields!!

…!?

This is a spatial-distortion weapon! The only things that can fight in here are our Roaring Steel suits with their spatial-synchronization fields!!

…!?

What is this!? It looks like a spatial-distortion weapon… We can't fight in a space like this!

…!?

What is this!? It looks like a spatial-distortion weapon… We can't fight in a space like this!

Hold it!

Makuu! I won't forgive you!! Johchaku!
Who are you!?
Space Sheriff Gavan!!
It takes Space Sheriff Gavan a mere 0.05 seconds to johchaku his Combat Suit. Now, let's look at the johchaku process once more.
It's a Space Sheriff! Don't let him leave alive!
So you're Hunter Killer!? Coward! Show yourself!

Ha ha ha…

Earth will soon belong to us, Makuu! Attack!!
Makuu! I won't let you do as you please! I'll protect the peace of Earth!!

Space Sheriff Gavan!?

He… he's still alive?

Space Sheriff Gavan!?

He… he's still alive?

…!?

You're the Galactic Union's S-class most wanted fugitive, Lucifard! What are you doing in a place like this… fighting Makuu!?

Space Sheriff…?

You mean a sheriff from space, right?

Space Sheriff…?

You mean a sheriff from space, right?
Nngh… Curse you, Space Sheriff Gavan! I won't lose next time! Remember that!
Ngh… Did I slip up!?

Oh… Is everyone all right!?

Thanks to you, the Cyclone's modification is finished. Thank you…
By the way, who are you?

I'm Gavan… a Space Sheriff of the Galactic Union Police, assigned to the Earth sector.

I came to Earth in pursuit of the space crime organization Makuu.
The space crime organization Makuu!?

A scientific crime syndicate that manipulates all the evil in the universe from the shadows and has conquered countless planets.

The one who rules that beast-star empire with overwhelming power is Don Horror!

…By the way, is that man one of your comrades?
